summary.text: Scott Louser is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives from District 5 in Minot who has served since December 2010 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a real estate broker who chaired the House Industry, Business and Labor Committee in 2023-2024.

paragraphs.text: Scott Louser lists his occupation as real estate broker and holds a B.S. and an M.S. from Minot State University.
Ballotpedia says he has worked as a licensed realtor since 1997 and as owner of Prudential Preferred Properties of Minot.
He has also served on the Minot Public School board and has three children.

Louser assumed office on December 1, 2010, and advanced from the Republican primary on June 9, 2026; the general election for the district's two seats also includes Republican Roger Brabandt and Democrats Kyle Erickson and Zach Raknerud.
He chaired the House Industry, Business and Labor Committee in the 2023-2024 session.
His 2025 assignments include the Appropriations Committee and its Education and Environment Division.
